slices.title: Run OHDER assessment during slice close
slices.description: Make ask slice close run ArchitectRuntime/OHDER assessment before auto verification, task completion, commit, and pre-push validation.
acceptanceCriteria: A slice-close contract test proves a blocking OHDER architect violation fails with code slice-close-ohder-blocked.
The blocked task remains in-progress and no slice commit is created.
Successful slice-close responses include the architect/OHDER assessment payload.
Existing clean slice-close behavior remains unchanged when OHDER passes.

slices.title: Emit architectural replayability events from slice close
slices.description: Record OHDER slice-close outcomes in the runtime ledger so architectural validation is replayable outside ask continue.
acceptanceCriteria: Slice close emits ArchitectValidationCompleted after OHDER assessment.
Slice close emits ReplayabilityValidated when replayability is acceptable.
Slice close emits ArchitectureViolationDetected events when OHDER law violations exist.
Failure paths still keep the task in-progress before commit.

slices.title: Add explicit hard and soft OHDER law taxonomy
slices.description: Teach the OHDER law pack to distinguish hard laws that block from soft laws that warn while preserving explicit outcome overrides and exemptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Law-pack tests prove lawClass hard blocks by default.
Law-pack tests prove lawClass soft warns by default.
Explicit law outcome overrides still work.
Existing exemption behavior still works.
Default scaffolded OHDER laws declare the appropriate lawClass.

slices.title: Add baseline architecture score output
slices.description: Add deterministic architecture scoring to ArchitectRuntime so OHDER status exposes weighted health beyond pass/fail law outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: ArchitectRuntime.assess returns architectureScore with overallScore, grade, and weighted categories.
Hard or blocking violations reduce the score more than soft warnings.
Entropy, coupling, and replayability risk affect score deterministically.
Architecture score is persisted in architect status.

slices.title: Document OHDER slice-close governance
slices.description: Update README and operations docs so operators understand the new slice-close OHDER gate, hard/soft laws, architecture score, and exemption path.
acceptanceCriteria: README states ask slice close runs OHDER before auto-complete and auto-commit.
Operations docs explain hard laws, soft laws, blocking behavior, and architecture score output.
Operator playbooks explain how to diagnose slice-close OHDER blocks.
Full test suite and ASK pre-push check pass after docs update.
